rules.statement: A transfer after the commencement of legal proceedings for partition is void under section 17 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1863.
rules.supporting_quote: " This transfer after commencement of legal proceedings to partition the land is void under section 17 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1863 (see Annamalai Pillai v. Perera, 6 N. L. R. 108). I decree that the deed executed by them in favour of the third defendant was void, and that the two sixth shares of Mahagedarawatta and of the houses thereon are liable to be sold in execution in case D.
